title: Ghostly Walking Tour in Victoria
includes: Ghostly Walks souvenirs (books, t-shirts etc) (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
policies: Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Behind Victoria’s old-world charm lie tales of eccentric characters, heroic deeds, intrigue, love, humour, hangings, murder and ghosts! During your 1 hour walking tour, expect to hear great storytelling as you travel through the streets and alleys of Victoria, a ghost-hunter’s paradise.
